description: Digital Display with Touch Control – Take command of your cooking with a sleek, user-friendly digital display and intuitive touch controls. Easily set your preferred cooking time and temperature, switch between pre-sets, or monitor progress with just a few taps—no complicated buttons or guesswork required. 8 Pre-Set Menu Options – Make mealtime a breeze with 8 versatile pre-set cooking modes including Frying, Baking, Grilling, Roasting, and more. Whether you're preparing crispy fries, juicy chicken, or fluffy baked goods, this air fryer takes the guesswork out of cooking by offering one-touch convenience and consistent, delicious results every time. Safety Lock for Child Protection – Cook with peace of mind knowing the built-in child safety lock prevents accidental operation. Combined with a cool-touch handle and overheating protection, this air fryer is designed to keep your kitchen safe for the whole family—especially with little ones around. Easy to Use and Clean 5L Pan – Cook generous portions in one go with the spacious 5-liter non-stick frying basket—ideal for families, guests, or meal prepping for the week. Say goodbye to batch cooking and hello to stress-free meal preparation for gatherings, holidays, and everyday dinners. 60-Minute Timer with Auto Shutoff – Achieve perfect results every time with the built-in 60-minute timer. Simply set your desired time and walk away—the air fryer automatically shuts off once the cooking cycle is complete, giving you both convenience and peace of mind.
